title: King of My Heart
notes: The chord sheet is in Bb and comes with the Bethel Moment video above. The studio recording on the album Starlight is in A, a half step lower, so this tab will not match that one.
The bass plays the letter of the chord: for Gm it plays G, for Cm it plays C.
Where the notes are: G is the open G string. F is the D string at fret 3 and Eb the D string at fret 1. Bb is the A string at fret 1 and C the A string at fret 3.
Keep your hand in one place: index finger on fret 1, ring finger on fret 3.
Learn Gm F Eb Bb first: it is the intro, every chorus and the second bridge. The bass walks down G, F, Eb, then Bb.
The song is slow: count 1 2 3 4 in every bar, a little faster than one count a second. Some charts give the tempo as 136, which is the same speed counted twice as fast.
Order of the song: Intro, Verse 1, Chorus four times, Verse 2, Chorus four times, Bridge 1, Chorus once more, Bridge 2, Ending.
A root-note arrangement written from the chord chart: one bar for each chord of Gm F Eb Bb. The bar lengths of the verse and the bridges are a reading of the chart, not checked against the recording.

tabs.note: One note per bar. Let it ring for all four counts.
Two notes per bar, on counts 1 and 3. Each line of the chart is four bars.

tabs.label: Main
tabs.note: A note on every count. After Bridge 1 the chorus comes once more, then Bridge 2.

tabs.label: Harder, for later
tabs.note: Twice as many notes: one on every count and one on every "and" between.

tabs.label: Start
tabs.note: Two notes per bar. Each line of the chart is two bars. The bridge goes round several times, louder each time.

tabs.label: As it builds
tabs.note: When the band gets louder, a note on every count.

tabs.label: Sung
tabs.note: The chorus chords with a note on every count, for as long as the band sings it.

tabs.label: Without words
tabs.note: The chart's line with no words. Two notes per bar; C is new here, the A string at fret 3. The last Eb is held for two bars.
One note per bar. Let the last Bb ring until the band stops.
